workflows.name: Reset Password Onload

CAPTURE.name: Capture recovery session if present
CAPTURE.__wwdescription: If the default email link redirected here with tokens, keep them. If not, the user can still enter a code later.

workflows.description: Capture tokens from the default reset email link when URL config is correct. Do not block the form if the user is resetting with a code instead.

interactions.name: Reset Password With Otp On Reset Page

GO.name: Go to login
GO.__wwdescription: Open the login page after a successful reset

varValue.code: 'Password updated. You can sign in now.'

TRY.name: Try verify and update
TRY.__wwdescription: Use the email-link session or verify a 6-digit code, then set the password

STOP.name: Stop propagation
STOP.__wwdescription: Stop the form click from bubbling

VERIFY.name: Verify then set password
VERIFY.__wwdescription: Use link session or POST recover OTP, then PUT the new password

VALIDATE.name: Validate code and passwords
VALIDATE.__wwdescription: Allow 6-character passwords. Skip OTP if the email link already created a session.

interactions.description: Set a new password from the email-link session or a 6-digit recovery code. Minimum 6 characters.
